LSJ,
Can Player A use Kindred Manipulation and Mob Rule to force another Player
B's vampire to burn blood to vote as Player A chooses?

Comments Welcome,
Norman S. Brown, Jr.
XZealot
Archon of the Swamp

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
XZealot wrote:
> LSJ,
> Can Player A use Kindred Manipulation and Mob Rule to force another Player
> B's vampire to burn blood to vote as Player A chooses?

No.
KM sets the aspect (yea or nay) of the votes that B's vampire casts. It
doesn't require him to have or to gain any votes, nor to cast any votes
he may have.
